pr_title: Fixes #7982 - Makes Users and Orgs API GET endpoint results standard to Github
pr_body:
Fixes #7982 

This makes it so we are getting all the information about a user or org like one gets with GitHub. It makes it so public API endpoints work, but respects email showing unless one is admin.

Also fixes a security hole where, as you can see in the diff of models/org.go, it was showing an org even if it was not set to public (was only going by if the member was public or not, but needs to go by if the org is private or not)

Also makes it so the API convert.go methods for model.User -> api.user uses the model.User.APIFormat() (reduces redundant code) but makes sure email is only show if API has a user logged in.
pr_comments:
@lunny Shouldn't be a break change, but it does make all the users/* API calls public like GitHub has them. Doesn't make sense to just have to be a Gitea user to query info about a user. But that is very open for discussion if we want to be more private than GitHub. As I posted in a review thread above, you can see these links for my account on GitHub without a token or authentication:

- https://api.github.com/users/richmahn
- https://api.github.com/users/richmahn/starred
- https://api.github.com/users/richmahn/subscriptions
- https://api.github.com/users/richmahn/gpg_keys
- https://api.github.com/users/richmahn/keys

Also, I added data to the GET responses for Users and Orgs, nothing removed.

[8086.zip](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/files/3695398/8086.zip)

Hi, @richmahn. Try this fix. The problem was that calling functions like `user.APIFormat()` will try to open a new connection (database session), which produces a concurrency problem if you already have one open (that `Engine` interface that's being passed around).

I think you'll be alright with this (it now passes the test in my computer).
Note: to apply that patch, simple unzip and use: `git apply 8086.diff`

## missing an API call to get all informations for an existing user

the call `GET /users/{username}` sends only a few user properties, 
but not enough to change some values (eg. allow_create_organization, or active) 
and send this changes back to server by API call `PATCH /admin/users/{username}`

Short: i missing the API call `GET /admin/users/{username}`

review_comments: Our long purpose here is to move all convertion from package `models` to `modules/convert`.
It's better to use `AfterLoad(sess *xorm.Session)` and resue `see` to load organization.

Done some extensive testing on all http://localhost:3000/api/v1/users/* API calls and all seems to be secure, in that everything public on GitHub is also the same in my branch of Gitea. I will keep testing this though, just to make sure all is secure.
Oh, I see... the whole point was to allow annonymous access. 🤦‍♂
Actually though your comment did catch something, that the tokens API was no longer usable with a token. I have fixed that.
